newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank of Italy bought marks for lira -- dealer.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Italy bought marks for lira -- dealer.

text.p: The Bank of Italy bought German marks for lira in the 970 lire/mark area, said one foreign exchange dealer.
The dealer said the Italian central bank bought marks at 970.70 lire and then at 970.80 lire in a move by the Bank of Italy that "gave a clear signal to the market", he said.
Dealers said they believed the central bank wanted the Italian currency to stabilise around the 970-971 lire/mark area.
Earlier, the lira touched a high of 969.95 lire/mark helped by the rally in the dollar.
The lira was last quoted at 971.40/971.70 lire/mark by 1510 GMT from 973.89 lire indicated on Friday.
